thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-2026-045 — decode-pool high OOM rate, auto-page oncall.

sam: paging from monitoring — CUDA OOMs on decode-0/1/2, containers restarting in loop.
maya: ack, joining from breakfast :coffee: What's the observed customer impact?
ricardo: router logs show ~3.8% request drops for streaming endpoint /v1/stream/generate, some 500s returned.
customer-support: AcmeCorp reported timeouts and truncated responses, they've opened a ticket.
leo: seeing repeated "CUDA out of memory" and `invalid memory access` in decode logs. stack:
```
E Cuda error: out of memory
at decode_step (decode.cpp:1234)
```
ops-bot: autoscaler attempted to add nodes but kube-scheduler delayed due to taints, 2 pods evicted.
sam: possible root cause: runaway generation — clients sending max_tokens set to 100000 in a batch of sessions.
maya: confirmed — recent frontend change removed max_tokens validation (PR #4587), user-supplied values passed directly to model.
sam: immediate mitigation plan:
- throttle ingestion to streaming endpoint
- apply per-request max_tokens cap via gateway
- route traffic off problematic nodes
- fallback to smaller model when memory pressure high

maya: doing config push to gateway to enforce 2048 token hard cap. running command:
```
shipctl apply-config --service gateway --set streaming.max_tokens=2048
```
sam: applying kube cordon/drain to decode-1 to isolate flappy node:
```
kubectl cordon node/decode-1
kubectl drain node/decode-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```
leo: rolled out a temporary policy in runtime to reject requests with max_tokens > 4096 and return 400 with hint. patch:
```
PATCH /runtime/validate
{ "max_tokens": { "max": 4096 } }
```
ops-bot: scaled decode-pool from 8 -> 12 GPUs to absorb traffic. new pods are coming up.
maya: switching routing rule in envoy to prefer decode-canary, reduce load on heavy nodes.
ricardo: started rolling back frontend PR #4587 to restore server-side validation.
sam: started killing runaway sessions using admin command to free KV cache:
```
./admin terminate-session --reason runaway-max-tokens --older-than 1h
```
customer-support: AcmeCorp reports errors decreasing, they see some retries succeeding :+1:
leo: after mitigations, OOM rate dropped from 7/min to <1/min. memory usage back to baseline.
maya: handing off to leo for overnight monitoring. leo, take it.
leo: taking over. I'll keep alerts on and run periodic checks every 15m. paging policy adjusted to higher sensitivity for decode OOMs.
maya: follow-ups: create postmortem, add server-side input validation, add unit tests, update runbook, coordinate customer comms.
sam: filed postmortem ticket PM-2026-118 and scheduled meeting tomorrow 10:00am PST.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-2026-045 mitigated; now in monitoring. Escalation to SEs if regressions in 2h.
